messages.Căldura primită de gaz se împarte mereu: The heat absorbed by the gas always splits in two: internal energy (which for an ideal gas depends only on temperature) and mechanical work. The splitting ratio is precisely γ.

messages.Lucrul mecanic într-o destindere adiabat: Mechanical work in an adiabatic expansion
messages.Aflați lucrul mecanic L efectuat de gazu: Find the mechanical work L done by the ideal gas in an adiabatic transformation from pressure p₁ between volumes V₁ and V₂. The adiabatic coefficient γ is given. Application: p₁ = 1 bar; V₁ = 10 cm³; V₂ = 20 cm³; γ = 1.4.
messages.Pompa verticală cu piston — problemă int: Vertical pump with a piston — integrative problem
messages.Un corp de pompă vertical de secțiune S,: A vertical pump barrel of cross-section S, fitted with a movable piston of mass M, contains nitrogen of mass m at temperature t₁. The atmospheric pressure is p<sub>a</sub>. The gas undergoes isobaric heating up to T₂, after which the piston is locked and the barrel is connected to a vessel of volume V₂. Find: a) the initial height h of the piston above the barrel base; b) the work L done by the gas during the isobaric heating; c) the final pressure p<sub>f</sub> after the connection is opened.
messages.Aplicație: S = 0,01 m²; M = 50 kg; m = 1: Application: S = 0.01 m²; M = 50 kg; m = 14 g; t₁ = 27 °C; p_a = 1 bar; T₂ = 400 K; V₂ = 3 dm³; p₂ = 4·10⁵ Pa; g = 10 m/s².

messages.Izobară: linie orizontală, iar L = p·ΔV: Isobaric: a horizontal line, and L = p·ΔV is the shaded rectangle.
messages.Izotermă: ramură de hiperbolă; aria de s: Isothermal: a hyperbola branch; the area under it is L = νRT·ln(V_f/V_i).
messages.Adiabată: aceiași extremi, dar curbă mai: Adiabatic: same end points, but a steeper curve (γ > 1); the area is the adiabatic work.

messages.<strong>3 translații = 3 grade de libert: 3 translations = 3 degrees of freedom. The atom can move independently along Ox, Oy and Oz. The monatomic model includes no internal rotations or vibrations.
messages.<strong>3 translații + 2 rotații = 5 gra: 3 translations + 2 rotations = 5 degrees of freedom. Initially, the bond is aligned with Ox. The Oy and Oz controls rotate the molecule relative to the fixed frame; a linear molecule has two orientational degrees of freedom. Rotation about the bond and vibrations are excluded in this rigid model.
messages.<strong>3 translații + 3 rotații = 6 gra: 3 translations + 3 rotations = 6 degrees of freedom. This example is a rigid nonlinear molecule, with three independent rotational axes. A linear polyatomic molecule has only two relevant rotations. Vibrations are excluded.
